newsitem.title: NORWAY: Fokus Bank jumps on takeover rumours.
newsitem.headline: Fokus Bank jumps on takeover rumours.

text.p: Shares in Norway's fourth largest commercial bank, Fokus Bank, jumped 8.3 percent on Friday in heavy trade on market rumours of a foreign takeover bid.
Fokus share was up 4.50 crowns at 64.50 crowns at 1045 GMT in turnover of 82 million crowns, the most heavily traded stock on the Oslo bourse in value terms.
Brokers said there was speculation that a major Swedish bank planned to make a bid for Fokus, which itself is bidding to take over niche Norwegian mortgage lender Bolig og Naeringsbanken (BNbank).
A market source told Reuters that at least one major investor was contacted late on Thursday by a broker enquiring if they were willing to sell their stake and at which price.
Bjarne Borgersen, managing director at Fokus, said the sharp rise in the share price had caused a stir at the bank.

"I have heard the same rumours and it has been very hectic at the bank this morning because of the jump in our share price. I checked up the rumours and have no reason to believe that they are true," Borgersen told Reuters.
